supplements.title: [Warming acupuncture combined with Duhuo Jisheng decoction for lumbar disc herniation of qi stagnation and blood stasis accompanied with liver-kidney deficiency: a randomized controlled trial].
supplements.summary: To compare the therapeutic effect between warming acupuncture combined with Duhuo Jisheng decoction and Duhuo Jisheng decoction alone in the treatment of lumbar disc herniation (LDH) of qi stagnati...

supplements.title: Baicalein suppresses colorectal cancer progression through dual inhibition of the Wnt/β--catenin and PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathways.
supplements.summary: Baicalein, a plant compound, slows colorectal cancer growth by simultaneously blocking two key cancer-promoting signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Dietary sugar intake as a risk factor for early-onset colorectal cancer in young New Zealanders.
supplements.summary: High sugar intake may increase early-onset colorectal cancer risk in young people, suggesting dietary changes could help prevent disease.

supplements.title: CGF induces ROS-mediated metabolic reprogramming and mitochondrial dysfunction to suppress colorectal cancer progression.
supplements.summary: CGF, a natural compound, inhibits colorectal cancer growth by disrupting metabolism and triggering cell death through mitochondrial damage.

supplements.title: Exploring Terpenoids as Dual-Action Agents in Diabetes and Cancer: A Review of Their Anti-Hyperglycemic, Anti-Glycolytic Actions, and Combination Therapy Potential.
supplements.summary: Terpenoids like zerumbone and carvacrol show promise in treating both diabetes and cancer by reducing blood sugar and tumor metabolism.

supplements.title: Natural Modulators of the TP53 Pathway: Potential Herbal and Plant-Derived Agents for Cancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Plant-derived compounds show promise in reactivating p53, a key cancer-fighting protein mutated in half of all human cancers.

supplements.title: Isoguanosine exerts anticancer effects in Huh-7 cells by modulating ROS-dependent MAPK and AKT signaling.
supplements.summary: Isoguanosine kills liver cancer cells by increasing cellular stress and blocking growth-related signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Systematic review on effectiveness of flavonoids against breast cancer: Insights from in-vitro, in-vivo studies and molecular pathway studies.
supplements.summary: Plant compounds called flavonoids show promise against breast cancer in lab studies, but human clinical trials are needed to prove effectiveness.

supplements.title: Chemical chaperone TUDCA rescues Insulin-mediated vascular relaxation via ER stress inhibition in diabetic rat model.
supplements.summary: TUDCA, a chemical compound, restores blood vessel relaxation in diabetic rats by reducing stress in cells.

supplements.title: The clinical application of parenteral nutrition with Omega-3 fatty acids in patients after gastrectomy: a retrospective cohort study and cost-effectiveness analysis.
supplements.summary: Omega-3 fatty acids added to IV nutrition after gastric cancer surgery reduced complications and improved cost-effectiveness compared to standard nutrition.

supplements.title: Berberine induces pyroptosis by promoting the NLRP3/Caspase-1/GSDMD pathway in papillary thyroid carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Berberine, a natural compound from Chinese herbal medicine, kills papillary thyroid cancer cells by triggering a specific cell death pathway.

supplements.title: Integrated phytochemical and computational approaches to identify candidate Bcl-2 inhibitors from Caesalpinia mimosoides: Toward translational anticancer strategies.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified plant compounds from Caesalpinia mimosoides that effectively block Bcl-2 cancer protein, offering natural alternatives to synthetic drugs.

supplements.title: Exploration of the pharmacological mechanism of Evodia rutaecarpa on esophageal cancer based on comprehensive analysis of compounds and disease targets.
supplements.summary: Evodia rutaecarpa compounds inhibit esophageal cancer cell growth by stopping cell cycle and triggering cell death through multiple molecular targets.

supplements.title: Targeting Warburg effect: involvement of lactate transporter MCT1 and its chaperone in cancer cell killing by 18β-glycyrrhetinic acid.
supplements.summary: A licorice-derived compound kills cancer cells by exploiting their lactate transporter, which is overexpressed due to rapid metabolism.

supplements.title: Xanthan gum intake modifies the colon microbiota profile and causes mild colon inflammation in rats.
supplements.summary: Xanthan gum, commonly used in food, causes mild colon inflammation and alters gut bacteria in rats.

off_label.title: Circadian disruption exacerbates MASH by reducing Akkermansia muciniphila via the FXR-CYP7A1-bile acid axis.
off_label.summary: Circadian disruption worsens liver disease by reducing beneficial gut bacteria through disrupted bile acid metabolism, reversible with bacterial or drug treatments.

off_label.title: Association between inhaled corticosteroids and anti-PD-1/PD-L1 efficacy in patients with NSCLC with concurrent COPD.
off_label.summary: Inhaled corticosteroids for COPD improve lung cancer immunotherapy response in patients with both conditions.

off_label.title: ACLY-Driven Metabolic Reprogramming Promotes Histone Acetylation and Inflammation-Associated Fibrosis in Chronic Kidney Disease.
off_label.summary: ACLY enzyme drives kidney fibrosis by increasing histone acetylation and inflammation; blocking it reduces fibrosis in chronic kidney disease.

off_label.title: Efgartigimod as Rescue Therapy for PD-1 Inhibitor-Associated Myasthenia Gravis, Myocarditis, and Myositis (MMM) Syndrome: A 2-Case Report and Literature Review.
off_label.summary: Efgartigimod shows promise as a rescue treatment for severe immune-related muscle and heart complications caused by cancer immunotherapy drugs.

off_label.title: CRITICAL ROLE OF DYSREGULATED AUTOPHAGY IN PATHOPHYSIOLOGY OF PODOCYTOPATHY.
off_label.summary: Restoring autophagy in kidney cells shows promise for treating podocytopathies by reducing protein loss and improving cell function.

off_label.title: Perindopril and L‑arginine protect against arsenic trioxide-induced neurotoxicity via Keap1/Nrf2/HO‑1 activation and suppression of neuroinflammation and apoptosis.
off_label.summary: Perindopril and L-arginine together protect against arsenic trioxide's nerve damage in leukemia treatment by reducing inflammation and cell death.

off_label.title: PBK-Loaded secretory autophagosomes drive radiotherapy-induced systemic adipose depletion via MAPK/ERK-PRKA/PKA-LIPE/HSL signaling: a therapeutic target for esophageal cancer cachexia.
off_label.summary: Radiotherapy for esophageal cancer causes harmful fat loss through secreted particles containing PBK; blocking PBK with OTS-514 restores fat and improves treatment.

off_label.title: Altered Sphingolipid Metabolism is Associated with Osimertinib Resistance in Nonsmall-Cell Lung Cancer.
off_label.summary: Lung cancer cells resist osimertinib by altering fat metabolism; combining the drug with a metabolism inhibitor restores treatment sensitivity.

off_label.title: Exenatide attenuates neuroinflammation and rescues sepsis-induced depressive behavior and cognitive dysfunction in a mouse model.
off_label.summary: Exenatide, a diabetes drug, reduces brain inflammation and improves depression and memory problems caused by sepsis in mice.

off_label.title: Multi-omics analysis of perfluorooctanoic acid and glioblastoma: insights from Mendelian randomization, network toxicology, and molecular docking.
off_label.summary: Genetically higher PFOA levels causally increase glioblastoma risk through neuroinflammation and oncogenic pathways, suggesting environmental and therapeutic implications.

off_label.title: Therapy-induced cholesterol biosynthesis drives lung cancer dormancy and drug resistance.
off_label.summary: Lung cancer cells evade drug therapy by making cholesterol, triggering dormancy; combining cholesterol-blocking statins with cancer drugs prevents this escape.

off_label.title: Evidence-steered medicine in oncology: network-aware micro-combinations that safeguard standard of care and potentially improve benefit-risk.
off_label.summary: Evidence-steered medicine adds tiny, timed drug doses to standard cancer therapy to restore immune function and improve outcomes while maintaining safety.

off_label.title: Synergistic action of JNK activation and BChE inhibition: a novel anti- glioblastoma compound with neuroprotective profile.
off_label.summary: A new drug called QY-54 kills glioblastoma cancer cells while protecting healthy brain tissue through dual mechanisms.

off_label.title: Qualitative Study on Experiences Related to Anorexia and the Effects of Anamorelin and Placebo in Advanced Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer Patients With Anorexia-Cachexia: A Preliminary Study
off_label.summary: Anamorelin may help improve appetite and reduce weight loss in advanced lung cancer patients experiencing loss of appetite.

off_label.title: Amyloid-β-driven glymphatic dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease model mice is driven by Ca2+-mediated increases in astrocytic cholesterol.
off_label.summary: Lowering calcium and cholesterol in brain cells restores waste-clearing glymphatic function and improves cognition in Alzheimer's disease models.

biomarkers.title: [Effects of electroacupuncture on gastrointestinal dysfunction and serum metabolites in postoperative patients with gastric cancer].
biomarkers.summary: Electroacupuncture helps gastric cancer patients recover digestive function faster after surgery by improving gut movement.

biomarkers.title: Durable response of anaplastic thyroid cancer to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy: A case report.
biomarkers.summary: Pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy produced a durable response in an aggressive anaplastic thyroid cancer patient.

biomarkers.title: Cost-effectiveness of pembrolizumab plus trastuzumab and chemotherapy for HER2-positive gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Pembrolizumab combined with trastuzumab and chemotherapy is cost-effective for HER2-positive gastric cancer in both the U.S. and China.

biomarkers.title: Therapeutic strategies of metabolic reprogramming in non-small cell lung carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Targeting metabolic reprogramming in lung cancer cells and their environment may overcome drug resistance and improve treatment outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Emergence of carbapenem-resistant putative hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae ST147 with a distinct hybrid plasmid in Türkiye.
biomarkers.summary: A dangerous antibiotic-resistant bacteria strain (ST147) is rapidly spreading in Turkey, carrying multiple resistance genes on a hybrid plasmid.

biomarkers.title: Personalizing Curative Therapy in Stage II to III Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers are developing personalized treatments for triple-negative breast cancer using new drug combinations and biomarkers to predict which patients will relapse.

biomarkers.title: Cytotoxicity and potential cell death mechanisms of three new benzamidine derivatives in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cells using in vitro and in silico approaches.
biomarkers.summary: Three new benzamidine compounds killed esophageal cancer cells more effectively than current chemotherapy, potentially triggering multiple cell death pathways.

biomarkers.summary: Baicalein, a plant compound, slows colorectal cancer growth by simultaneously blocking two key cancer-promoting signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Evaluation of the impact of glycolysis-related gene signatures on prognosis and therapeutic targeting in lung adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified eight glycolysis-related genes that predict lung adenocarcinoma prognosis and suggest personalized drug treatments for patients.

biomarkers.title: Proposal for an Objective and Concrete Definition for Determining Anatomic Resectability in Pancreatic Cancer: The Concept of the 'Suitable Target'.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers propose identifying disease-free vessel segments above and below tumors to determine if advanced pancreatic cancer surgery is feasible.

biomarkers.title: Dietary sugar intake as a risk factor for early-onset colorectal cancer in young New Zealanders.
biomarkers.summary: High sugar intake may increase early-onset colorectal cancer risk in young people, suggesting dietary changes could help prevent disease.

biomarkers.title: The use of blood biomarkers in lung cancer screening in Aotearoa New Zealand: a cross-sectional survey of Māori perspectives and preferences.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers surveyed Māori people in New Zealand about their willingness to provide blood samples for lung cancer screening tests.

biomarkers.title: HPV Prevalence Among Inuit Women in Northern Quebec, Canada: A Pre- and Post-Vaccination Analysis.
biomarkers.summary: HPV vaccination in Quebec reduced high-risk human papillomavirus infection rates among Inuit women in northern Quebec after 2008.

biomarkers.summary: Circadian disruption worsens liver disease by reducing beneficial gut bacteria through disrupted bile acid metabolism, reversible with bacterial or drug treatments.

biomarkers.title: A stress-induced PI3P complex controls autophagy in erythroid precursors.
biomarkers.summary: A protein called Samd14 controls autophagy in red blood cell precursors, helping them survive and develop properly during anemia.

trials.summary: Researchers developed targeted antibodies that trigger cell death specifically in HER2-overexpressing cancers while minimizing harmful inflammatory side effects.

trials.summary: Blocking KIF20A in liver cancer restores immune cell function and improves anti-PD-1 immunotherapy by disrupting lactate-driven tumor escape mechanisms.

trials.title: Immune hub genes and a proof-of-concept prognostic signature in EBV-associated gastric carcinoma.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a four-gene immune signature to predict survival outcomes and guide treatment in EBV-associated gastric cancer.

trials.title: Temperature and pH-dependent potassium currents of muscles of the stomatogastric nervous system of the crab, Cancer borealis.

trials.title: Association between inhaled corticosteroids and anti-PD-1/PD-L1 efficacy in patients with NSCLC with concurrent COPD.

trials.title: AK5 suppresses breast cancer progression and modulates anti-PD-L1 efficacy via the miR-182-5p/PD-L1 axis.
trials.summary: AK5 protein suppresses breast cancer growth and enhances immunotherapy effectiveness by reducing a molecule that blocks immune responses.

trials.title: Therapeutic manipulation and spatial quantification of the tumor microenvironment in colorectal cancer.
trials.summary: Blocking TGFβ signaling in colorectal cancer remodels fibroblasts and immune cells, offering a measurable way to track treatment response.

mind_body.title: The effectiveness of electroacupuncture in the treatment of cancer-related fatigue: a systematic review.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture appears to help reduce fatigue in cancer patients, though more research is needed to confirm effectiveness.

mind_body.title: Spirituality and Religiosity in Adults With Head and Neck Cancer: A Scoping Review of Concepts, Measures, and Outcomes.
mind_body.summary: Spirituality and religiosity may help improve health outcomes in head and neck cancer patients, but research needs standardized measurement approaches.

mind_body.title: Effects of Psychosocial Interventions on Measures of Stress Among Breast Cancer Survivors: A Scoping Review.
mind_body.summary: Psychosocial interventions effectively reduce stress in breast cancer survivors, potentially improving immune function and survival outcomes.

mind_body.title: Health Related Quality of Life (HRQL) and Symptom Assessment in Patients Diagnosed With Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma (DIPG) or Recurrent and Re-irradiated Brain Tumours and Their Caregivers: A Non-Therapeutic Study
mind_body.summary: Study measures quality of life and symptoms in children with DIPG or recurrent brain tumors receiving repeat radiation treatment.

mind_body.title: A Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial of a Social Network Intervention for Older Patients With Cancer
mind_body.summary: A pilot study tests whether a social network intervention improves outcomes for older adults with advanced cancer.

mind_body.title: Chemotherapy-Induced Gastrointestinal Dysfunction: Mechanisms and Integrative Western-Chinese Medicine Strategies.
mind_body.summary: Chemotherapy damages the gut through multiple interconnected processes; combined Western and Chinese medicine approaches targeting specific mechanisms may better prevent and treat these side effects.

mind_body.title: Optimizing Integrative Oncology Approaches to Address Chemotherapy-induced Peripheral Neuropathy in Gastrointestinal (GI) Cancer Patients: A SMART Pilot Study
mind_body.summary: Study tests whether Tai Chi, supplements, or acupuncture can reduce nerve damage caused by chemotherapy in gastrointestinal cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Effects of Mindfulness-Based Interventions on the Psychological Well-Being of Family Caregivers of Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based interventions significantly reduce anxiety and depression in family caregivers of cancer patients.

mind_body.title: eHealth Mindfulness-based Music Therapy Intervention for Patients Undergoing Stem Cell Transplantation
mind_body.summary: Researchers are testing an online mindfulness and music therapy program to improve quality of life in blood cancer patients undergoing stem cell transplants.

mind_body.title: Community-Engaged Pilot Testing of Talking About Cancer (TAC) to Improve Engagement in Advance Care Planning
mind_body.summary: Telephone coaching helps advanced cancer patients and caregivers plan end-of-life care through guided conversations and advance directives.
